data.question: Do I need deep technical skills?
data.answer: No. Core system works with simple copy-paste/upload on any AI platform. Advanced options exist for power users, but they're optional.

data.question: Which AI platforms does this work with?
data.answer: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, NotebookLM... Basically any AI that accepts custom instructions and/or file uploads.

data.question: How long does setup take?
data.answer: Basic setup: 2-3 hours. Advanced MCP implementation: a weekend. Time savings compound quickly—you'll earn it back fast.

data.question: Will this work for my niche/industry?
data.answer: Yes. The system analyzes YOUR writing samples, so it works regardless of topic, industry, or content type.

data.question: What if I don't have enough writing samples?
data.answer: Start with what you have. You can add more later. It's not a showstopper—the system improves as you use it.

data.question: Is this just better prompts?
data.answer: No. This is a complete SYSTEM for training AI to understand YOU—your voice, style, strategy, business, and audience. Prompts are included, but they're just one component. Other guides give you prompts. This gives you an ecosystem.

data.question: Do I get updates?
data.answer: Yes, through the private community. As the guide improves, you get access to updates.

data.question: Can I get support?
data.answer: Yes—private community access for questions and knowledge sharing.

data.question: Can this help with more than just writing?
data.answer: Absolutely. Once AI knows your voice and business, it helps with podcasts scripts, branding and marketing feedback, product development brainstorming, communication, ads, and more. The system is versatile.

data.question: Is this the launch price?
data.answer: Yes. €49.99 is the introductory launch price. It won't stay this low forever as the guide continues to evolve with new content and techniques.

data.question: How is this different from other AI writing guides?
data.answer: Most guides give you prompts. Prompts work once. This gives you a complete system that evolves and improves over time. It teaches you to capture your voice, document your strategy, add business context, and build an AI that truly understands you—not just follows instructions.

data.question: What results can I expect?
data.answer: Day 1: first draft that sounds like you. Week 1: full system configured and working. Month 1: dramatically faster content creation with minimal editing. Month 3+: AI becomes a true creative partner you can't imagine working without.
